summary: Round 1's blocking F1 is gone — the false :latest gloss no longer appears at decisions.md:599, and the provenance narrowing the ruling asked for is intact and correct. But the clause that replaced it makes a second estate-wide claim the ruling did not ask for, and this one is falsified by the HelmCharts deploy path and by the prd cluster: every first-party image HelmCharts deploys runs digest-pinned. One advisory finding rides along on V04's wording.

findings.summary: decisions.md:599 now says images we build ourselves are not digest-pinned and the tag is the consuming site's call; HelmCharts' deploy resolves every release image to @sha256: (resolve_helm_args.py:148, Jenkinsfile:189-191) and eleven first-party prd Deployments run that way.

The landed line deliberately states no first-party tag norm (right, per round 1's evidence), while V04 and the ruling at plan.md:67-68 both name one — V04 needs the operator's ruling at acceptance; recorded as close-out B14.
